tab.title: Security
tab.disabled: Security Center is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.stale: Could not read the host, showing the last reading. {{error}}

card.title: Security
card.empty: No hosts are watched yet. Turn on Security Center in a host's settings.

overview.noRoot: The checks ran without root, so some keys and sshd settings may be missing. Allow passwordless sudo for this login.
overview.clean: No problems found with the keys on this host

keys.empty: No keys found on this host
keys.hint: Removing a key keeps a backup next to the file.
keys.rotateText: Termix adds a new key, checks that it logs in, saves it as a credential and points this host at it. Only then is the old key removed. If anything fails, nothing changes.
keys.hostKeysText: Every client, Termix included, will see a changed host key the next time it connects. The old keys are copied on the host first.
keys.revokeText: {{user}} will no longer be able to log in with {{print}}. A backup of the file is kept.

vulns.off: Vulnerability scanning is turned off. An admin can turn it on in the plugin settings.
vulns.none: This host was not scanned yet. Scan now, or wait for the next scheduled scan.
vulns.unsupported: Vulnerability data is not available for {{os}}. Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine, Rocky Linux and AlmaLinux are supported.
vulns.failed: The last scan failed, showing older results. {{error}}
vulns.pending_one: {{count}} advisory is still being looked up. Scan again in a few minutes for its severity.
vulns.pending_other: {{count}} advisories are still being looked up. Scan again in a few minutes for their severity.
vulns.noKev: The list of known exploited vulnerabilities could not be loaded.

settings.alertsHint: Send an alert for new critical findings and new critical or exploited vulnerabilities.
settings.age: Report keys files not changed in (days)

enable.label: Security Center
enable.description: Audit the SSH keys on this host and scan it for known vulnerabilities.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Run the checks with passwordless sudo so every user's keys can be read.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Block key rotation and removal from Termix.

showPanel.label: Show the side panel
showPanel.description: Offer the Security panel beside terminals on this host.

scanVulns.label: Scan for vulnerabilities
scanVulns.description: Send installed package names and versions to OSV to find known vulnerabilities. Turn off to keep package lists on your network.

osvUrl.label: OSV address
osvUrl.description: Where to look vulnerabilities up. Change it to use your own OSV mirror.

checkKev.label: Check known exploited list
checkKev.description: Download the CISA list of known exploited vulnerabilities once a day to mark the urgent ones.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the Security panel with terminals
companionAutoOpen.description: Open the panel by itself on hosts that have it.

companionSide.label: Panel side
companionSide.description: Where the Security panel opens beside a terminal.

companionSize.label: Panel size
companionSize.description: Width or height of the panel in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the edge of the terminal to open the panel.

use.title: Use Security Center
use.description: See keys, findings and vulnerabilities on hosts you can access.

scanVulns.title: Scan for vulnerabilities
scanVulns.description: Start a vulnerability scan from Termix.

rotate.title: Rotate and remove keys
rotate.description: Rotate login keys and host keys, and remove keys from hosts.

revokeKey.title: Remove an SSH key
revokeKey.pathHint: The full path of the authorized keys file.
